players.product: Ceramic housings and aluminium nitride ceramic substrates for optical communication modules

quarterly_data.signal: Sinopack 2025 revenue RMB 2,878,069,759.31, up 8.67% (2024: RMB 2,648,495,638.64); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 562,674,690.41, up 4.36%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 535,151,489.95, up 15.13%; operating cash flow RMB 951,707,228.00, up 75.77%, which the company attributes mainly to more sales orders and higher cash received from sales. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 613,825,226.42, Q2 RMB 784,219,514.55, Q3 RMB 745,316,863.66, Q4 RMB 734,708,154.68 (Q4 net profit RMB 119,386,364.61). Overall gross margin 37.18%, up 0.77 pt.

Sinopack 2025 revenue by product (before intersegment elimination of RMB -436,662,066.62): electronic ceramic materials and components RMB 2,011,130,877.23 (60.67%, up 7.12%, gross margin 29.45%, up 2.10 pt); third-generation semiconductor devices and modules RMB 1,303,600,948.70 (39.33%, up 2.51%, gross margin 37.94%, up 1.67 pt). Main subsidiaries: Hebei Bowei (GaN RF devices) revenue RMB 1,019,976,158.91, net profit RMB 283,529,586.93; Guolian Wanzhong (GaN / SiC chips and devices) revenue RMB 632,566,468.30, net profit RMB 212,220,284.03. Direct materials rose to 67.33% of cost of sales (2024: 63.64%).
quarterly_data.figure: electronic ceramics RMB 2,011,130,877.23 (+7.12%, GM 29.45%); third-gen semiconductors RMB 1,303,600,948.70 (+2.51%, GM 37.94%)

quarterly_data.signal: Sinopack 2025 sales volume 174,993,959 units (pieces / sets), up 34.28%; output 194,752,459, up 45.31%; year-end inventory 34,829,817, up 130.73%, which the company attributes to revenue growth and a changed product mix. Inventory rose mainly on more orders and more goods shipped but not yet accepted at year-end (goods in transit RMB 426,120,524.33 vs RMB 170,838,696.86). Fixed assets rose as construction in progress was transferred into service and equipment was bought.

Sinopack (annual report): its aluminium nitride thin-film substrates are in volume supply; it says it is the largest domestic maker of high-end electronic ceramic housings and that its market share in ceramic housings and substrates for optical-module packaging is among the global leaders. Its optical-communication device housings and substrates cover transmission rates of 2.5Gbps up to 800Gbps, 1.6Tbps and 3.2Tbps, which it says matches foreign peers' technology.

Sinopack 2025 R&D projects for optical communication: a 1.6T multilayer thin-film substrate (aluminium nitride multilayer substrate for high-speed modules) has its finalized product made and is preparing for testing and verification; a single-lane 128G ceramic housing for coherent 400G long-haul transmission (128GBd) passed customer verification of its prototype; a 400G COB metal substrate has its finalized product made and processes fixed; a 25G low-cost glass housing for PON access networks finished small-batch production and end-customer verification.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.6T multilayer thin-film substrate; 128G coherent ceramic housing; 400G COB metal substrate

quarterly_data.signal: Sinopack (annual report) on its other businesses: its ceramic heater for semiconductor equipment passed user verification and is used in volume in domestic semiconductor equipment, and its electrostatic chuck passed on-tool verification at a leading domestic semiconductor equipment company; precision ceramic parts revenue rose sharply. Subsidiary Hebei Bowei is, by its own account, China's largest GaN RF device and module maker, with main customers among the international telecom equipment leaders and a domestic number-one share in its segment. Guolian Wanzhong's SiC power products are in volume supply for on-board chargers at leading automakers and passed main-drive inverter validation at several automakers.
Sinopack 2025 R&D spending RMB 328,268,353.85, up 13.23%, 11.41% of revenue (2024: 10.95%), none capitalised; R&D staff 264 (30.70% of employees).

Sinopack top five customers were 58.88% of 2025 sales (RMB 1,694,696,029.42); the largest 25.48% (RMB 733,408,737.94), then 11.56%, 9.00%, 8.72% and 4.13%; names not disclosed; sales to related parties among them 4.13% of sales.

quarterly_data.signal: Sinopack top five suppliers were 46.71% of 2025 purchases (RMB 1,024,149,532.02); the largest 32.18% (RMB 705,727,713.14), then 6.52%, 3.23%, 2.97% and 1.81%; names not disclosed; purchases from related parties among them 32.18% of total purchases.
quarterly_data.figure: top five suppliers 46.71% of 2025 purchases; largest 32.18%; related-party purchases 32.18%

quarterly_data.signal: Sinopack construction in progress at end-2025: RMB 441,177,812.17 (start of year RMB 508,223,069.62). Major projects: electronic ceramic housing production line (self-funded) at 63% progress, with RMB 214,993,445.55 invested in 2025 and RMB 598,704,419.95 cumulative; GaN microwave product precision manufacturing line 17%; communication power amplifier and microwave IC R&D center 33%; third-generation semiconductor process and packaging / test platform 17%; SiC high-voltage power module key-technology R&D project 37%. 2025 investment totalled RMB 567,079,773.13, up 41.38%.
quarterly_data.figure: CIP RMB 441,177,812.17; ceramic housing line 63% complete

quarterly_data.signal: Sinopack 2026 business plan (annual report): keep its technology lead and raise market share, deepen cooperation with leading customers and win more large customers; increase investment to lift capacity and digitise production lines; accelerate the raised-fund projects (GaN microwave product precision manufacturing line, communication power amplifier and microwave IC R&D center, third-generation semiconductor process and packaging / test platform, SiC high-voltage power module R&D). It aims to become a world-class electronic ceramics supplier.
